author: Davidgo5867

english.text: We have watched the fortunes of eight successive human species for a thousand million years, the first half of that flicker which is the duration of man. Ten more species now succeed one another, or are contemporary, on the plains of Neptune. We, the Last Men, are the Eighteenth Men. Of the eight pre-Neptunian species, some, as we have seen, remained always primitive; many achieved at least a confused and fleeting civilization, and one, the brilliant Fifth, was already wakening into true humanity when misfortune crushed it. The ten Neptunian species show an even greater diversity. They range from the instinctive animal to modes of consciousness never before attained. The definitely sub-human degenerate types are confined mostly to the first six hundred million years of man's sojourn on Neptune.

text: 我哋睇咗八個連續嘅人類物種嘅命運一千萬年，嗰個閃爍嘅前半部分，即係人類嘅持續時間，而家仲有十個物種喺海王星嘅平原上互相接替，或者係同時代嘅。我哋，最後嘅人，係第十八個人類。喺八個海王星前嘅物種當中，正如我哋所見，有啲永遠都係原始嘅；好多人至少實現咗一個混亂而短暫嘅文明，而其中一個，聰明嘅第五個，當不幸壓碎咗佢嗰陣，已經醒咗成為真正嘅人類。十個海王星物種顯示出更大嘅多樣性。佢哋嘅範圍由本能嘅動物到從未達到過嘅意識模式。絕對係亞人類嘅退化類型大多局限於人類喺海王星嘅頭六億年。
